nodes.code:
import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(9.1, 9.4)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(25.35, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .box(32.9, 9.1, 5.6)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(46.7, 0, 0.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(9.1, 5.4)
    )
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(10.8)
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(46.7, 0, 0.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(13.65, 2.6)
    )
    .faces("+Z").edges().chamfer(1.3)
)
show_object(result)

    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(25.35, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .box(32.9, 9.1, 5.6)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(46.7, 0, 0.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(9.1, 5.4)
    )
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(10.8)
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(46.7, 0, 0.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(13.65, 2.6)
    )
    .faces("+Z").edges()
    .filter(lambda e: not (e.geomType() == "CIRCLE" and (abs(e.radius() - 2.6) < 1e-6 or (abs(e.radius() - 5.4) < 1e-6 and e.Center().x < 20))))
    .chamfer(1.3)
)
show_object(result)

import cadquery as cq
import math
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(9.1, 9.4)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(25.35, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .box(32.9, 9.1, 5.6)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(46.7, 0, 0.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(9.1, 5.4)
    )
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(10.8)
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(46.7, 0, 0.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(13.65, 2.6)
    )
    .faces("+Z").edges().chamfer(2.6 / 2, (2.6 / 2) * math.tan(math.radians(45)))
)
show_object(result)
